entry.author: Waimakariri District Council
entry.summary:
Water infrastructure is making headlines around New Zealand — but what does it mean here in Waimakariri?

From drinking water and wastewater to stormwater and flood resilience, this video takes a closer look at the networks, infrastructure, and planning that help keep our communities running every day.

Across the district, more than 21,500 properties rely on these essential services — supported by treatment plants, underground pipes, drainage systems, and the people working behind the scenes to maintain them.

This episode of the “Do You Know… Waimakariri?” series explores:
💧 Drinking water and treatment upgrades
🚰 Wastewater services
🌧️ Stormwater and climate resilience
🏗️ Infrastructure investment and renewals
📍 Local Water Done Well and local water management

Learn more about the services that support everyday life in Waimakariri:
https://www.waimakariri.govt.nz/do-you-know/do-you-know-waimakariri
